title: तीसरा नियम आँखें बंद मत करना! | रात के किस्से
topic: हिमालय की सोमेश्वर गुफा के सबसे गुप्त गर्भगृह में राघव का तीसरा और सबसे जानलेवा सामना
description:
सोमेश्वर गुफा का तीसरा नियम इतना भयानक था कि राघव की चीख निकल गई। क्या वह इस अंधेरे जाल से ज़िंदा निकल पाया?

जब परछाईं भी साथ छोड़ दे और तापमान शून्य से नीचे गिर जाए, तब क्या होता है? जानिए इस रोमांचक और डरावनी कहानी में, जहाँ हर कदम पर मौत मंडरा रही है।

ऐसी ही रहस्यमयी और डरावनी कहानियों के लिए 'रात के किस्से' चैनल को अभी सब्सक्राइब करें!

#HorrorStories #HindiHorror #BhootiyKahani #RaatKeKisse #Shorts
thumb_text: तीसरा नियम: आँखें बंद मत करना!

scenes.text: क्या आप जानते हैं कि जब परछाईं आपका साथ छोड़ दे, तो ज़िंदा रहने की उम्मीद खत्म हो जाती है?
scenes.style: deep, chilling, direct question to the audience with suspenseful pauses
scenes.visual: English: Raghav walking cautiously inside a dark Himalayan rock cave with stone walls, holding a flickering torch, dim orange lighting, medium wide shot.
shots: Raghav walking cautiously inside a dark Himalayan rock cave with stone walls, holding a flickering torch, dim orange lighting, medium wide shot.
Raghav stopping in fear inside the dark Himalayan cave as the shadow behind him completely disappears from the rocky ground, wide shot.
Raghav looking down at the empty stone floor where his shadow should be, holding a burning torch with trembling hands, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: राघव ने सोमेश्वर गुफा के पहले दो जानलेवा नियम तो पार कर लिए थे, पर असली परीक्षा अब शुरू हुई थी।
scenes.style: tense, low whisper, building the terrifying atmosphere
scenes.visual: English: Raghav standing at the edge of a narrow tunnel inside the ancient Himalayan cave, looking intensely forward, cold blue mist on the ground, wide shot.
shots: Raghav standing at the edge of a narrow tunnel inside the ancient Himalayan cave, looking intensely forward, cold blue mist on the ground, wide shot.
Raghav carefully stepping over massive fallen boulders blocking the ancient cave passage, holding a wooden torch high, medium wide action shot.
Raghav wiping sweat from his forehead with his sleeve while navigating a complex maze of dark stone corridors inside the cave, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: गुफा के तीसरे और आखिरी गर्भगृह के द्वार पर पहुँचते ही हवा का तापमान अचानक शून्य से भी नीचे गिर गया।
scenes.style: shaky voice, trembling with growing fear
scenes.visual: English: Raghav facing massive ancient stone carved doors covered in strange frost and symbols, holding his cargo jacket tightly, wide cinematic shot.
shots: Raghav facing massive ancient stone carved doors covered in strange frost and symbols, holding his cargo jacket tightly, wide cinematic shot.
Frost rapidly spreading across the stone floor toward Raghav's boots as he steps back in alarm inside the dark Himalayan sanctum, wide shot.
Raghav exhaling a thick cloud of white breath into the freezing air while reaching out a gloved hand toward the icy cave door, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: दीवारों पर लिखे उस तीसरे नियम को पढ़कर राघव के रोंगटे खड़े हो गए... आँखें बंद मत करना!
scenes.style: intense, booming whisper, grave warning tone
scenes.visual: English: Close-up of ancient mysterious glowing inscriptions carved on a black cave wall with Raghav standing beside it in shock, wide composition.
shots: Close-up of ancient mysterious glowing inscriptions carved on a black cave wall with Raghav standing beside it in shock, wide composition.
Raghav holding his torch closer to the chilling warning carved on the stone wall, his eyes wide with absolute dread, medium shot.
Raghav stepping backward from the cursed wall inscription, dropping his hand in utter disbelief inside the silent Himalayan cavern, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अंधेरे कोने से एक भारी आवाज़ गूंजी और ठीक उसके पीछे कुछ ऐसा हुआ जिसने साँसें रोक दीं।
scenes.style: terrified, breathless gasp, building sudden panic
scenes.visual: English: Raghav reacting sharply with wide eyes as strange shadows move on the cave walls behind him, torchlight flickering violently, wide action shot.
shots: Raghav reacting sharply with wide eyes as strange shadows move on the cave walls behind him, torchlight flickering violently, wide action shot.
A heavy wooden torch slipping from Raghav's trembling fingers as an unseen monstrous shadow lunges toward him across the cave floor, wide shot.
Raghav spinning around frantically in the dark cave as terrifying humanoid shadows detach completely from the stone walls, dramatic wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी देखने के लिए नीचे दिए गए वीडियो पर क्लिक करें!
scenes.style: fast, urgent, compelling call to action

Raghav running desperately into the deep darkness of the Himalayan cavern away from the glowing blue trap, wide cinematic angle shot.
